lines.zh: 蹦蹦跳跳向前行，金黄甲壳映阳光。
lines.en: Jumping and hopping, golden shell glitters.

lines.zh: 琥珀之身轻如风，追逐猎物不留情。
lines.en: Amber body, chasing prey without mercy.

lines.zh: 琥珀甲壳闪烁光，掠食者脚步不停。
lines.en: Amber shell gleams, predator’s steps relentless.

lines.zh: 琥珀碎片附其身，疾行如影匿无形。
lines.en: Amber shards, moving like a shadow.

lines.zh: 琥珀之甲闪金光，疾跑猎物难逃藏。
lines.en: Golden armor, running like lightning.

lines.zh: 金甲库卡疾奔来，猎物难逃其锋芒。
lines.en: Cuca in golden armor, running with sharpness.

lines.zh: 琥珀甲中藏锋芒，猎物近在咫尺方。
lines.en: Amber armor hides sharpness, prey within reach.

lines.zh: 金黄之甲跳跃疾，追踪猎物不留余。
lines.en: Golden armor, jumping fast, preying unrelenting.

lines.zh: 金黄甲壳库卡行，琥珀碎片随身藏。
lines.en: Cuca in golden shell, carrying amber shards.

lines.zh: 琥珀库卡轻捷行，锋利爪牙捕猎忙。
lines.en: Amber Cuca, swift and sharp, hunting busy.
A kick of four legs clears the shrub.

lines.zh: 甲壳擦过草叶，沙沙作响。
lines.en: Its shell rustles through the grass blades.

lines.zh: 琥珀甲壳静伫立，猎物在望待出击。
lines.en: Amber shell standing, prey in sight, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 静立金甲库卡间，琥珀碎片微光闪。
lines.en: Golden Cuca standing, amber shards glimmering.

lines.zh: 琥珀甲中显从容，静候猎物现踪形。
lines.en: Amber shell showing calm, waiting for prey to appear.

lines.zh: 库卡静立琥珀甲，等待猎物显形踪。
lines.en: Cuca in amber armor, waiting for prey to show.

lines.zh: 琥珀之甲显威严，静待猎物现踪形。
lines.en: Amber shell showing might, waiting for prey to appear.

lines.zh: 静伫琥珀甲中藏，等待猎物现身前。
lines.en: Standing in amber armor, waiting for prey to show.

lines.zh: 静待猎物显形踪，琥珀甲中显从容。
lines.en: Waiting for prey to appear, amber shell showing calm.

lines.zh: 琥珀之甲显威严，静待猎物现身间。
lines.en: Amber shell showing might, waiting for prey to appear.

lines.zh: 静伫琥珀甲中藏，猎物现身待出击。
lines.en: Standing in amber armor, waiting for prey to show.

lines.zh: 琥珀甲中显从容，静待猎物现身前。
lines.en: Amber shell showing calm, waiting for prey to appear.

lines.zh: 琥珀目光锐如刀，猎物锁定不放松。
lines.en: Amber gaze sharp as a knife, locking on prey.

lines.zh: 库卡琥珀目注视，猎物锁定不放松。
lines.en: Cuca with amber eyes, locking on prey.

lines.zh: 琥珀目光锐如针，猎物锁定不放松。
lines.en: Amber gaze sharp as a needle, locking on prey.

lines.zh: 猎物在目琥珀眼，锁定不放待出击。
lines.en: Eye on the prey, amber eyes locking in.

lines.zh: 琥珀目光如锋刃，锁定猎物不放松。
lines.en: Amber gaze like a blade, locking on prey.

lines.zh: 琥珀目光锐如剑，锁定猎物不放松。
lines.en: Amber gaze sharp as a sword, locking on prey.

lines.zh: 琥珀目光锐如炬，锁定猎物不放松。
lines.en: Amber gaze sharp as a torch, locking on prey.

lines.zh: 琥珀目光锐如矢，锁定猎物不放松。
lines.en: Amber gaze sharp as an arrow, locking on prey.

lines.zh: 琥珀目光锐如鹰，锁定猎物不放松。
lines.en: Amber gaze sharp as an eagle, locking on prey.

lines.zh: 琥珀目光锐如锥，锁定猎物不放松。
lines.en: Amber gaze sharp as a锥, locking on prey.

lines.zh: 身体受了伤，飞蛾扑火般挣扎！
lines.en: Injured, struggling like a moth to the flame!
Wounds bleeding, covered in scars!
Another wound on my body!
Pain from the wound, unbearable!
Injured, but still strong!

lines.zh: 伤口处渗出琥珀般的液体！
lines.en: Wounds oozing amber-like liquid!
Bruised and wounded, undeniable!
Injured, movement impaired!
Wounds gory and raw!
Injured, but not giving up!

lines.zh: 咕噜噜，琥珀味道真甜美。
lines.en: Rumble, amber tastes sweet.
Player, amber is my treasure!

lines.zh: 我这张鳄鱼脸，凑近看更吓人。
lines.en: My crocodile face is worse up close.

lines.zh: 琥珀的甜味盖不住我身上的腥。
lines.en: The sweetness of amber cannot hide the reek on me.
Get hit by me!

lines.zh: 琥珀是我的食物，我的生命。
lines.en: Amber is my food, my life.
Player, I’m Cuca!
Amber, my only love.

lines.zh: 琥珀色的夜里，我认出你。
lines.en: In the amber night, I know you.
Amber, my dream.

lines.zh: 撞上我吧，品尝我的怒火。
lines.en: Collide with me, taste my fury.
My amber teeth click loudly.
Your luck is running out.

lines.zh: 我的鳄鱼尾扫过来，躲不开。
lines.en: My caiman tail sweeps across; there is no dodging.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的那块琥珀，是我的。
lines.en: The amber you crushed underfoot was mine.
Player, you’re in the wrong place.
Avoid me, or you’ll get hurt.
Player, you’ve angered me.
My speed is fast, be careful.
Player, you can’t escape.
Find my mate, fight.
My mate, be with me.
I need a partner, come quick.
Only my mate can understand me.
Dance with me, my mate.

lines.zh: 我的爱人，只在月圆时来。
lines.en: My beloved only comes at the full moon.

lines.zh: 我的爱人，快来与我相聚。
lines.en: My mate, come join me.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，只有你能救我。
lines.en: My mate, only you can save me.
My mate, fight or flee.
My mate, for the rest of our lives.
Amber glows brightly.
It bites off a piece of wood.

lines.zh: 牙齿发出咯吱声，碎裂了骨头。
lines.en: Teeth crunch, breaking bones.
Teeth gnaw on leaves.

lines.zh: 琥珀碎片从它口中滑落。
lines.en: Amber slides from its mouth.
It chews nuts on the ground.

lines.zh: 琥珀碎片在阳光下熠熠生辉。
lines.en: Amber shines under the sun.
It chews rotting fruit.

lines.zh: 牙齿咬碎了坚硬的岩石。
lines.en: Teeth bite through hard stone.

lines.zh: 它从地底挖掘出琥珀碎片。
lines.en: It digs up amber from the ground.
It sniffs out player scent.

lines.zh: 它盯着玩家，眼睛闪烁着光芒。
lines.en: It stares at the player, eyes glowing.
It locks onto the player.
My crocodile-skinned hand points at you.
It aims at the player to attack.

lines.zh: 我帽檐下的老妇脸笑了一下。
lines.en: The old woman's face under my hat smiles.
It tracks the player's trail.
It locks onto the player's movement.
It waits for the best attack opportunity.

lines.zh: 它锁定玩家并开始攻击。
lines.en: It locks onto the player and attacks.
It stops and tilts its head to listen.

lines.zh: 琥珀色的爪尖刮过石块。
lines.en: Amber claws scrape across the stone.

lines.zh: 它从灌木后露出一只眼。
lines.en: One eye shows from behind the bush.

lines.zh: 你在它的地盘上踩出了声。
lines.en: You have made noise on its ground.

lines.zh: 它的甲壳竖起来，像块盾。
lines.en: Its shell rises like a shield.

lines.zh: 它记住了你站的这棵树。
lines.en: It marks the tree you stand by.

lines.zh: 我的鳄爪扣进你脚下的树根。
lines.en: My caiman claws dig into the roots beneath you.
Its voice is full of anger.
Its eyes flash with fury.
It starts moving towards the player.
It lets out a low growl.
Its sharp fangs show.
It opens its mouth to attack.
Its body leans forward.

lines.zh: 我帽檐下的眼睛，从不眨。
lines.en: The eyes under my hat never blink.

lines.zh: 它准备用爪子攻击玩家。
lines.en: It prepares to attack with its claws.
A caiman's body, an old woman's face.
Four feet knead the dirt in turn.

lines.zh: 它绕半圈，堵住你的退路。
lines.en: It circles halfway to cut off your retreat.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的低吼越拖越长。
lines.en: The growl in its throat drags longer.

lines.zh: 爪子收进甲壳，又弹出来。
lines.en: Its claws pull into the shell and snap out again.
It waits for you to turn first.
A raw amber smell hits your face.
It looks up, pupils narrowing to slits.

lines.zh: 你听见它牙齿磕了一下。
lines.en: You hear its teeth click once.
The distance is just right for one leap.
Clawing and biting at you.

lines.zh: 巨大的触手围攻你的脸。
lines.en: Tentacles surround your face.
You feel its hard shell.

lines.zh: 它用大颚撕裂你的皮肤。
lines.en: Its large mandibles tear at your skin.
Its deadly bite force.
Tentacles wrap around your body.
It pierces your flesh with spikes.
Its bite infects you.

lines.zh: 它强壮的尾巴挥动起来。
lines.en: Its strong tail swings.

lines.zh: 你被夹在它的大颚之间。
lines.en: You are caught in its large mandibles.
A forepaw slaps your shin!
It lunges whole and pins you down!

lines.zh: 獠牙从甲壳下探出，咬住！
lines.en: Tusks slide from under the shell and bite!
Its tail whips your head aside!
It leaps a man's height and crashes down!

lines.zh: 琥珀色的爪子划开你的衣甲！
lines.en: Amber claws tear open your gear!

lines.zh: 撞进你怀里，用牙找喉咙！
lines.en: It slams into your chest and bites for the throat!
Two quick rakes, then half a step back!

lines.zh: 咬住你的袖子，往地上拖！
lines.en: It bites your sleeve and drags you down!

lines.zh: 它把爪子钉进你的靴子！
lines.en: It drives a claw into your boot!
Emerges from the shadows slowly.
Scouring caves for food.
Stalks in the swamp at night.
Hunts at night.
Silent in the darkness.
Crawls out from underground.
Appears in the rotting forest.
Wakes during the sleepless night.
Drawn by the darkness.
Hides deep in the swamp.

lines.zh: 夜里，琥珀色的影子爬出洞。
lines.en: At night an amber shape crawls from a hole.

lines.zh: 草丛一响，库卡已经站定。
lines.en: The grass stirs; Cuca is already standing there.

lines.zh: 身体受了伤，飞蛾扑火般挣扎，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Injured, struggling like a moth to the flame! — and the fire makes it worse.
Burned by falling flames!
Drowned in an amber lake!

lines.zh: 伤口渗血，满身伤痕，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Wounds bleeding, covered in scars! — and the explosion makes it worse.
Hit by amber shards, injured!

lines.zh: 身上多了一道伤痕，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Another wound on my body! — and the magic makes it worse.
Starvation weakens my body!

lines.zh: 伤口疼痛，难以承受，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Pain from the wound, unbearable! — and the lightning makes it worse.
Vanish into the void!
